data.name: Shalini
data.gender_notes: Shalini is used as a female name in hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Sanskrit śīla, 'conduct, character' — śālinī, 'possessing good conduct'. Its root is Sanskrit śīla (शील). A classical Sanskrit term for good conduct. Shalini is a Sanskrit name meaning “Modest; well-behaved; bashful”. Families who choose it generally do so for the quality the name expresses.
data.spiritual_meaning: Shalini expresses “Modest; well-behaved; bashful”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.
data.etymology: From the Sanskrit śīla, 'conduct, character' — śālinī, 'possessing good conduct'.
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Shalini total 36, reducing to 9. Number 9 is associated with compassion, idealism and completion.
